svg.title: Upstream KiCad length constants against interposer geometry

g.aria-label: locked-item shadow margin from silkscreen width
dialog minSize, finest upstream grid preset
five grid presets added below the upstream
0.01 mm floor: 5 µm, 1 µm, 100 nm, 10 nm, 1 nm
two of these stop being lengths at all: the zone filler prunes with ten per cent of the half zone minimum width
rather than a constant, and squared distances widen to int64, so the 46 µm limit disappears rather than moving down the axis
